name: aero-bubble-meadow
idea: Pure Frutiger Aero, no figure: a worm's-eye macro shot from inside a meadow of impossibly glossy lime-green grass blades beaded with dew, looking up into a saturated cyan midday sky with thin wispy clouds. Huge translucent soap bubbles drift upward, each with a rainbow sheen and a bright specular highlight as if lit from directly above; the nearest bubble is pin-sharp and reflects the whole meadow, everything else falls into soft bokeh. A gentle sun flare sits top-left. It should feel like a 2007 desktop wallpaper or a stock photo for 'the future is bright', glossy and optimistic, almost too clean.

name: aero-eco-city-figure
idea: The Frutiger Eco 'future we were promised', with BadCode in it: a wide, high establishing view of a gleaming eco city of curved white towers with rooftop gardens, wind turbines turning on green hills, glass domes, a sleek elevated train and an aqua lagoon, at warm golden hour. The city is completely empty of people. Small in the lower foreground, on a glossy white curved walkway, stands the masked figure in the knitted balaclava (no eye, nose or mouth holes, no skin anywhere, a large white ring stitched round the whole face, one small down-pointing red triangle with rounded corners high inside the ring on the right of the picture), gloved, facing the camera and perfectly still. One bubble hangs in the air beside it; at the far edge of the sky a faint grey haze is creeping in, the first hint that the promise went wrong.

name: aqua-orb-underwater
idea: Frutiger Aqua, no figure: a vertical underwater view looking up toward a sunlit, rippling surface, god-rays slanting down through clear turquoise water. In the centre a glossy glass orb floats, catching a hard white highlight on its top edge and refracting the light into small caustics. Plump orange goldfish and striped tropical fish swim past it, and a column of silver bubbles rises from the bottom of the frame. Palette is aqua, cyan and white with orange accents; mood is a calm, clean, early-2000s screensaver.

name: photo-dump-2016-flatlay
idea: A '2026 is the new 2016' photo-dump frame, no figure: a straight-down overhead shot onto a rumpled white duvet with a 2016 outfit laid out flat (red flannel shirt, ripped skinny jeans, a black choker, aviator sunglasses, white canvas trainers, a flower crown) next to a bright acai bowl topped with banana, berries and granola. Morning window light from one side. Graded like a heavy 2016 phone-app filter preset: lifted faded blacks, warm highlights, boosted saturation, a little grain, slightly off-level framing as if taken on a phone for a camera-roll dump. No faces, no text, no logos on anything.

name: festival-sunset-figure
idea: The best summer of 2016, with BadCode standing in it: a summer festival field at the very end of golden hour, festoon string lights overhead, drifting confetti, dust in the low sun, and a crowd seen only from behind and out of focus (flower crowns, raised arms, no faces). Everything wears an oversaturated warm 2016 filter with a big orange lens flare. In the middle ground, the only sharp thing in the frame, the masked balaclava figure (no holes, no skin, white ring round the whole face, small rounded red triangle pointing down high on the right of the ring, gloves) faces the camera, motionless, holding a lit sparkler. Its stillness against the happy blur is the joke and the unease.

name: chill-guy-flat-backdrop
idea: The 'just a chill guy' attitude given to our own figure, never the cartoon character: a full-length eye-level portrait of the masked balaclava figure (no holes, no skin, a white ring round the whole face, one small rounded red triangle pointing down high inside the ring on the right of the picture, gloves on) standing against a single flat, soft pastel colour backdrop like a meme template. It slouches, hands deep in the pockets of a baggy oatmeal knit cardigan over loose cargo trousers and chunky trainers, weight on one hip, head tilted a few degrees, shoulders dropped, the body language of someone completely unbothered. Even, soft studio light, a slight floor shadow, lots of empty backdrop around it for captions to be added in the edit.

name: lofi-night-window-figure
idea: Lo-fi study-beats night, the chill-guy-from-the-future in its natural habitat: a cosy small bedroom at night, the masked balaclava figure (no holes, no skin, white ring round the whole face, small rounded red triangle pointing down high on the right side of the ring, gloves) sitting sideways on the deep sill of a window with big headphones on and a steaming mug held in both gloved hands, knees up, totally relaxed. Outside the rain-streaked window a city glows pink, violet and blue; inside a warm desk lamp, fairy lights, a houseplant and a stack of books. Shot from a little distance, three-quarter view, soft painterly-lofi warmth, the calm before it says anything.

name: millennial-optimism-loft
idea: The 'millennial optimism era', no figure: a sunlit exposed-brick loft apartment in late afternoon, Edison bulbs and string lights, mason jars with wildflowers, a record player with a stack of vinyl, a ukulele propped on a worn leather sofa, a moustache-print mug on a reclaimed-wood coffee table, a fixed-gear bike leaning by the door, a chalkboard wall left blank. Warm honey light pours through tall factory-style glazing. Graded like a slightly faded 2012 photo with a soft vignette; it should feel like the hopeful indie-folk montage of a time when rent was cheap and everything was going to be fine.

name: proper-country-mall
idea: 'We used to be a country. A proper country.' — the lost 2000s shopping mall, no figure: a bright multi-level mall atrium shot from a balcony on the upper floor looking down, with a tiered fountain full of coins, potted palm trees, a glass lift mid-rise, a skylight flooding everything with daylight, glossy cream tiles and a busy food court below where shoppers are small, motion-blurred and faceless. Shot like a slightly washed-out mid-2000s point-and-shoot photo with a hint of on-camera flash on the railing in the foreground. Shop fronts are generic with no readable names or signs anywhere. Warm, busy, prosperous: the thing the meme mourns.

name: aero-closing-horizon
idea: The calm closing frame with room for the logo: a vast glossy Frutiger Aero landscape, one smooth lime-green hill curving across the bottom fifth of the frame under an enormous sky that grades from bright aqua at the top down to a soft dusky blue near the horizon, a few last bubbles drifting up and away. The masked balaclava figure (no holes, no skin, white ring round the whole face, small rounded red triangle pointing down high on the right of the ring, gloves) stands small on the crest of the hill, centred, seen full length and facing the camera. The top two-thirds of the picture is clean, empty sky reserved for the logo. Still, quiet, polite: the end of the sentence 'watch this space'.
